{"program":"domain(person,[caden,ainhoa,clay,brinley]).

% If Caden has a vision, then he either sets goals or creates plans, but not both.
axiom(s1, rule([has_vision(caden)], xor(sets_goals(caden), creates_plans(caden)))).
% If Caden either sets goals or tracks progress (but not both), then he stays motivated.
axiom(s2, rule([xor(sets_goals(caden), tracks_progress(caden))], stays_motivated(caden))).
% Caden does not make an impact.
axiom(s3, not(makes_impact(caden))).
% Caden suffers setbacks.
axiom(s4, suffers_setbacks(caden)).
% Ainhoa suffers setbacks.
axiom(s5, suffers_setbacks(ainhoa)).
% If Clay has ambition, then he either creates plans or takes action, but not both.
axiom(s6, rule([has_ambition(clay)], xor(creates_plans(clay), takes_action(clay)))).
% If Ainhoa either sets goals or tracks progress (but not both), then he stays motivated.
axiom(s7, rule([xor(sets_goals(ainhoa), tracks_progress(ainhoa))], stays_motivated(ainhoa))).
% If Clay suffers setbacks, then he either refuses to give up or stays motivated, but not both.
axiom(s8, rule([suffers_setbacks(clay)], xor(refuses_to_give_up(clay), stays_motivated(clay)))).
% Clay pursues his passion.
axiom(s9, pursues_passion(clay)).
% Caden takes action.
axiom(s10, takes_action(caden)).
% Caden pursues his passion.
axiom(s11, pursues_passion(caden)).
% If Caden suffers setbacks, then he either refuses to give up or stays motivated, but not both.
axiom(s12, rule([suffers_setbacks(caden)], xor(refuses_to_give_up(caden), stays_motivated(caden)))).
% If Caden has ambition, then he either creates plans or takes action, but not both.
axiom(s13, rule([has_ambition(caden)], xor(creates_plans(caden), takes_action(caden)))).
% Clay takes action.
axiom(s14, takes_action(clay)).
% Anyone who has support or learns from failure can stay motivated.
axiom(s15, rule([or(has_support(X), learns_from_failure(X))], stays_motivated(X))).
% If someone believes in themselves, then they work hard and set goals.
axiom(s16, rule([believes_in_themselves(X)], and(works_hard(X), sets_goals(X)))).
% Caden does not track progress.
axiom(s17, not(tracks_progress(caden))).
% If Caden either identifies problems or evaluates risks (but not both), then he creates plans.
axiom(s18, rule([xor(identifies_problems(caden), evaluates_risks(caden))], creates_plans(caden))).
% Everyone who pursues their passion either makes an impact or has a vision (or both).
axiom(s19, rule([pursues_passion(X)], or(makes_impact(X), has_vision(X)))).
% Ainhoa has ambition.
axiom(s20, has_ambition(ainhoa)).
% Caden has ambition.
axiom(s21, has_ambition(caden)).
% Brinley does not face adversity.
axiom(s22, not(faces_adversity(brinley))).","query":"labelled_explanation(can_overcome_challenges(caden), Status, Package)"}
